identity.title: Creative Problem Solver · Executive Producer · Writer · Showrunner
identity.tagline: Uniquely crafting our experiences into the stories that allow history to aptly depict what it truly meant to be human.
identity.summary: 25+ years transforming raw human experience into culture-shaping television, film, editorial, and digital media. From TV One's first $1M+ reality franchise and BET's flagship news desk to VH1's award-winning story arcs, Goldman Sachs impact campaigns, and pandemic-era public-health PSAs — I architect stories that ship: pitch to greenlight, control room to broadcast, blank page to published essay.
